newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TML TIGHT-LIPPED ON PEARSON TALKS.
newsitem.headline: TML TIGHT-LIPPED ON PEARSON TALKS.

text.p: South African publisher Times Media Ltd (TML) kept tight-lipped about plans for an alliance with Britain's Pearson Plc after announcing half-year results on Monday.

Company officials declined to comment further on an earlier cautionary announcement that Pearson, publisher of the Financial Times, was negotiating to buy a stake in TML's Business Day and the weekly Financial Mail.
The statement follows months of speculation that the British media group was eyeing the two South African publications.
Industry sources said last week that talks between TML and Pearson were well advanced with the two companies planning to parcel off TML's business publications into a new jointly controlled company.

The move follows a deal last month which saw control of TML pass into black hands after a grouping of black business interests bought 35 percent of Johnnies Industrial Corporation, which in turn controls TML.
